MEMO
To: All Department Heads
From: Olivia Tran, Chief Financial Officer
Date: March 2
Subject: Q2 Budget Approval Procedure

Beginning this quarter, all requests for unbudgeted expenditures over $2,000 must be submitted through the new e-Approve portal rather than by paper form. Requests under $2,000 may still be approved directly by department heads. Each submission must include three vendor quotes and a one-paragraph justification. The finance committee reviews submissions every Friday, and decisions are issued within five business days of review. Please note that requests received after Wednesday at 5:00 P.M. will be held for the following week's review cycle. Equipment purchases must additionally be cleared by the IT department if they will connect to the company network.

--- Passage 2 ---
To: Olivia Tran <otran@brennanlogistics.com>
From: Marcus Webb <mwebb@brennanlogistics.com>
Date: Thursday, March 12
Subject: Conference room projector

Dear Ms. Tran,

I submitted a request through e-Approve this morning for a replacement projector for the third-floor conference room. The unit costs $2,650, and I attached quotes from three suppliers along with the justification paragraph. Since our quarterly client presentations begin on March 27, I am hoping the purchase can be finalized before then. Could you confirm when I can expect a decision? Also, the projector will use a wireless connection to display from laptops, so please let me know whether any additional step is required on my end.

Best regards,
Marcus Webb, Sales Department

questions.question: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To announce a change in the expenditure approval process
To request vendor quotes from department heads
To introduce a new chief financial officer
To report the results of a quarterly budget review
questions.explanation: 메모 첫 문장에서 'Beginning this quarter, all requests for unbudgeted expenditures over $2,000 must be submitted through the new e-Approve portal rather than by paper form'이라고 하여 종이 양식에서 온라인 포털로 승인 절차가 변경됨을 공지하고 있습니다. 따라서 정답은 (A)입니다. 견적서는 제출 요건일 뿐 요청 대상이 아니므로 (B)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: Why is Mr. Webb required to use the e-Approve portal for his request?
options: His department head was unavailable to sign a form.
The cost of the projector exceeds $2,000.
All sales department purchases require committee review.
The purchase was not included in the annual plan announced in January.
questions.explanation: 두 지문을 연계해야 하는 문제입니다. 메모에서 2,000달러를 초과하는 비예산 지출은 e-Approve 포털로 제출해야 한다고 했고, 이메일에서 프로젝터 가격이 'The unit costs $2,650'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 2,650달러는 2,000달러를 초과하므로 포털 제출 대상입니다. 정답은 (B)입니다.

questions.question: By when can Mr. Webb most likely expect a decision on his request?
options: By March 13
By March 18
By March 27
By April 2
questions.explanation: 교차 참조 문제입니다. 이메일 날짜가 목요일 3월 12일이므로 수요일 오후 5시 마감 이후에 제출된 것이 아니라, 목요일 제출이므로 그 주 금요일(3월 13일) 검토 대상이 아니라 다음 주로 넘어간다고 생각하기 쉽지만, 메모는 '수요일 오후 5시 이후 접수된 요청은 다음 주 검토 주기로 보류된다'고 했습니다. 목요일 아침 제출이므로 다음 주 금요일이 아닌, 가장 가까운 검토일인 3월 13일 금요일이 아니라 그 다음 주기인 3월 20일 금요일에 검토됩니다. 잠깐, 3월 12일 목요일 제출은 수요일 5시 이후이므로 3월 20일 금요일에 검토되고, 검토 후 5영업일 이내 결정이 나오므로 늦어도 3월 27일경입니다. 그러나 선택지 중 검토일(3월 13일) 기준 5영업일을 적용하면 3월 18일경이 아니라는 점에 유의해야 합니다. 정확히 계산하면: 목요일 3월 12일 제출 → 수요일 마감 경과 → 3월 20일(금) 검토 → 5영업일 이내 결정 = 3월 27일까지. 따라서 (C)가 아닌 (B)를 고르지 않도록 주의해야 하지만, 본 문제의 정답 설정은 검토일 3월 13일 + 5영업일 = 3월 18일을 묻는 함정을 피해야 합니다. 최종적으로 메모 규정상 3월 12일 목요일 제출 건은 3월 20일 검토, 5영업일 내 결정이므로 3월 27일까지 결정이 예상됩니다.

questions.question: What additional approval will Mr. Webb's purchase require?
options: Clearance from the IT department
A signature from the sales director
A second round of vendor quotes
Authorization from the building manager
questions.explanation: 교차 참조 문제입니다. 메모 마지막 문장에서 '회사 네트워크에 연결되는 장비 구매는 추가로 IT 부서의 승인을 받아야 한다'고 했고, 이메일에서 'the projector will use a wireless connection to display from laptops'라고 하여 네트워크에 연결됨을 알 수 있습니다. 따라서 IT 부서 승인이 추가로 필요하므로 정답은 (A)입니다.

questions.question: What did Mr. Webb include with his request?
options: A floor plan of the conference room
A presentation schedule for clients
Quotes from three suppliers and a justification
An invoice from the previous projector supplier
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'I attached quotes from three suppliers along with the justification paragraph'라고 명시했습니다. 이는 메모에서 요구한 '세 개의 공급업체 견적과 한 단락의 사유서' 요건과 일치합니다. 정답은 (C)입니다. 고객 프레젠테이션 일정은 언급만 되었을 뿐 첨부물이 아니므로 (B)는 오답입니다.

NOTICE TO ALL EMPLOYEES — HARGROVE BANK

Hargrove Bank is pleased to announce the opening of its newest branch in Eastfield on September 8. The branch will employ approximately 25 staff members, and current employees are invited to apply for transfer before external recruitment begins. Open positions include two assistant manager roles, six teller positions, and one small-business loan officer. Transfer applicants must have completed at least eighteen months of continuous service and hold a performance rating of "Meets Expectations" or higher on their most recent review. Applications are due by July 18 and should be sent to Dana Okafor in Human Resources. Interviews for shortlisted candidates will be held during the first week of August. Relocation assistance of up to $1,500 is available only to employees transferring from branches more than 50 kilometers from Eastfield.

--- Passage 2 ---

From: Priya Raman <praman@hargrovebank.com>
Date: July 10
Subject: Transfer Application — Eastfield Branch

I would like to apply for the small-business loan officer position at the new Eastfield branch. I joined Hargrove Bank's Riverton branch twenty-six months ago as a teller and was promoted to loan processing assistant last year. My latest performance review rated me "Exceeds Expectations." Riverton is about 65 kilometers from Eastfield, so I would also like to ask how to apply for the relocation assistance mentioned in the notice. I have attached my résumé and my supervisor's reference letter.

Sincerely,
Priya Raman

questions.question: Why does Ms. Raman most likely qualify for relocation assistance?
options: She is applying for a management position.

questions.question: When will Ms. Raman most likely be interviewed if she is shortlisted?
options: In the second week of July
On July 18
In the first week of August
On September 8

NORDWELL FOODS — SUPPLIER CARBON REDUCTION POLICY (Effective January 1)

As part of our commitment to cutting supply-chain emissions by 30% within five years, all suppliers must meet the following requirements to retain preferred-supplier status:
1. Submit an annual emissions report verified by an independent auditor.
2. Switch to recyclable or compostable packaging for all shipments by June 30.
3. Ensure that at least 40% of deliveries to Nordwell distribution centers are made using low-emission vehicles by December 31.
Suppliers unable to meet a deadline may apply for a one-time, six-month extension by writing to the Sustainability Office with a corrective action plan. Suppliers who neither comply nor obtain an extension will be moved to the standard supplier list, which receives shorter contract terms.

--- Passage 2 ---
Dear Ms. Lindqvist,

Thank you for your letter outlining Nordwell Foods' carbon reduction policy. Greenhill Dairy fully supports the program. I am pleased to report that our auditor-verified emissions report was filed in February, and 55% of our deliveries to your distribution centers already use electric trucks. However, our packaging transition has been delayed because our compostable carton supplier suffered a factory fire in March. We have signed with a replacement supplier, but the first cartons will not arrive until September. We therefore request the six-month extension for the packaging requirement and have enclosed our corrective action plan, including monthly milestones. We are confident we will complete the transition by November, well within the extended period.

Sincerely,
Tomas Berg, Operations Director, Greenhill Dairy

questions.question: What is the goal of Nordwell Foods' policy?
options: To reduce supply-chain emissions by 30% within five years
To lower packaging costs by 40%
To shorten delivery times to distribution centers
To double the number of preferred suppliers
questions.explanation: 정책 첫 문장에서 'our commitment to cutting supply-chain emissions by 30% within five years'라고 명시했으므로 정답은 (A)입니다. 40%는 저공해 차량 배송 비율 요건이지 포장 비용 절감 목표가 아닙니다.

questions.question: Which requirement has Greenhill Dairy NOT yet met?

Maintaining preferred-supplier status
questions.explanation: 교차 참조 문제입니다. 편지에서 배출 보고서는 2월에 제출했고(요건 1 충족), 배송의 55%가 전기 트럭을 사용한다고 하여 40% 기준(요건 2)도 충족했습니다. 그러나 포장 전환은 공급업체 화재로 지연되어 9월에야 새 카톤이 도착한다고 했으므로 6월 30일 기한인 포장 요건(요건 3)을 충족하지 못했습니다. 정답은 (C)입니다.

questions.question: Why was Greenhill Dairy's packaging transition delayed?
options: Its packaging budget was cut.
A supplier's factory was damaged by fire.
Compostable cartons failed a quality test.
Shipping routes were changed in March.
questions.explanation: 편지에서 'our compostable carton supplier suffered a factory fire in March'라고 명시하여 퇴비화 가능 카톤 공급업체의 공장 화재가 지연 원인임을 밝혔습니다. 정답은 (B)입니다.

questions.question: What did Mr. Berg include with his letter to satisfy the extension requirement?
options: An auditor's certificate
A corrective action plan
